chapter_title: Concerning the Three Blows that befell the Enemy b
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶1:** Falsity from evil — the selfhood that opposes the Divine — has been overcome through three spiritual combats, three progressive states of judgment; and in each successive combat, divine wisdom inflicted upon it a deeper devastation than the last.

**¶2:** The first: The selfhood was drawn out from its interior concealment into the open and separated from the natural mind in its state of falsity, the ground from which it had arisen. It was overcome in that first spiritual combat, seized and [GAP-1] restrained by the divine life indwelling the human spirit.

**¶3:** The second devastation is the state in which falsity from evil is dissolved and its coherence destroyed, and it perishes in the consuming fire of divine love. It is destroyed and overthrown — stripped of every phantasy and false appearance through which it sustained its existence. And it will be gathered back [GAP-2] into the constraint proper to its essential form, and reduced to the condition it possessed from its first origin.

**¶4:** The third devastation that will befall the selfhood is the final reversal [GAP-3] at the ultimate judgment, when all things will be separated, and the intellectual element of evil will be divided [GAP-4] from the volitional element. Now, the understanding that served evil will be bound into the congealed mass of falsity, but the will of evil [GAP-5] will be cast into spiritual death. For they will be divided [GAP-6] by an immovable ultimate truth set between them, for age upon age, unto eternity.

**¶5:** This is the manner in which the total restraint of the selfhood opposed to the Divine will be accomplished — a constraint absolute and unbreakable, from which there is no release — because [GAP-7] the powers of divine order have accomplished its binding and confined it for eternity. And they have accomplished its complete separation, and it has been set apart forever.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The Darkness itself, the enemy, has received three bad blows with three wars; and worse dangers from the light in those three wars.
The first: (The enemy) was brought out to the middle and separated from his dark earth, whence he had departed. He was vanquished in that first war, caught and [bound] by the living soul.

The second blow is the time when he will be dissolved and melted, and he perishes in this great fire. He is destroyed and overthrown, from the images that are all by which he exists. And he will be gathered in [to the] fetter corresponding to his archetype, and be made like he was from the first beginning.

The third blow that will befall the enemy is the 'rolling back' [at the] end when everything will be separated, and male will be divided [from] female. Now, the male will be bound in the lump, but the female [will be thrown] in to the tomb. For it will be divided [and sealed by a great] stone in their midst, for generation upon generation, for ever and ever.

This is the way that the binding of the enemy will come about, in a fetter that is burdensome and strong, one from which there is never escape; because [they have achieved] his binding and bound him for ever. And they have achieved his being set apart, and he has been set apart for ever.

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading says "restrained by the divine life," and "bound" is the exact natural-plane term for restraint/binding by the living soul in Manichaean cosmological register — confirmed.
The spiritual reading says "gathered back into the constraint proper to its essential form," and "to the" correctly connects "gathered in" to "fetter corresponding to his archetype" — confirmed.
The spiritual reading says "the final reversal at the ultimate judgment," and "at the" correctly links "rolling back" to "end when everything will be separated" — confirmed.
The spiritual reading says "the intellectual element will be divided from the volitional element," and "from" is the standard preposition for separation/division — confirmed.
The spiritual reading says "the will of evil will be cast into spiritual death," and "will be thrown in to the tomb" exactly corresponds to being cast into spiritual death — confirmed.

The spiritual reading says "divided by an immovable ultimate truth set between them"; "and sealed" captures the immovable, permanent quality of the separation, while "by a great" connects to "stone in their midst."
The spiritual reading says "the powers of divine order have accomplished his binding," and "they have achieved" accurately renders the accomplished action by the divine powers — confirmed.
